facts.fact: The Federal High Court in Abuja held that the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs violated the Freedom of Information Act, 2011, by refusing a request for information, so the Act is in force.

Justice Binta Nyako of the Federal High Court ordered the Ministry to release the Ondo cash-transfer beneficiary list within seven days and awarded N2m damages for breaching the applicant's right under the FOI Act.

NGA.note: The document is about a court order on disclosure of beneficiary names and states nothing on how payments are made.
Nothing on local government office connection.
Names the Conditional Cash Transfer Programme but states nothing on a management information system.
